title: Commission invests €3.4 billion in net-zero technology projects
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 19 Oct 2026 Today, the European Commission has selected 77 European net-zero technology projects to receive funding support worth €3.4 billion under the second call of the Innovation Fund, launched in December 2025.

title: EU invests over €390 million in 135 new climate and environment projects
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 19 Oct 2026 The European Commission has today granted more than €390 million to 135 new projects across Europe under the LIFE programme for environment and climate action.
